s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, tie into knots and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with garlic butter and parmesan. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with tomato paste and cheese, roll, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough, spread with sauce and top with 200g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 100g mushrooms. Bake at 240C for 12 minutes. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese, 200g sugar and 3 eggs, pour over and bake at 160C for 55 minutes. Chill overnight.

d.how: Pour cold cola over ice in 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
